description: This Java class, JsonArrayValueValidator, is part of the Eclipse Ditto project and provides validation logic to ensure a JSON array contains only string elements. It parses a CharSequence into a JsonArray, checks each element's type, and throws an exception if non-string values are present or if parsing fails.

classes.name: JsonArrayValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton final class responsible for validating that a JSON array contains only string items. It extends AbstractHeaderValueValidator and implements validation logic for headers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of JsonArrayValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates that the provided CharSequence, when parsed to a JsonArray, contains only string values, throwing an exception otherwise.

methods.name: tryToParseJsonArray
methods.description: Attempts to parse the String value into a JsonArray, throwing an exception if parsing fails.

methods.name: containsNonStringArrayValues
methods.description: Checks whether the JsonArray contains any non-string values.
